criteria.requirement: Repair RFC unfolding in rrulestr(unfold=True)/compatible and tzical so both SP and HTAB continuation prefixes join the preceding content line, removing exactly one prefix character. Preserve existing default non-unfold rules, blank-line policy and value whitespace; do not strip all content. Verify actual recurrence instances and offset of a folded VTIMEZONE. No external calendars, network or zone service.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
